# Agent HUD 0.6.0
## Compatibility
**Requires Agent HUD for iPhone 1.7.2 or later** for iPhone and Apple Watch sync. Update the iPhone app before updating the Mac. Older iPhone versions cannot read this release's data.
[Get the iPhone app](https://apps.apple.com/app/id6812113619).
Requires an Apple Silicon Mac running macOS 14 or later.
## Changes
### Before you update
- The first launch reads every agent log still on disk to count your token history. Agent HUD keeps working meanwhile, and the Usage page shows how far back it has read; with a lot of history this takes a while. - Your settings and the last 30 days of quota history come along. Don't open an earlier version afterwards: it doesn't find this data, or deletes tokens older than 31 days. - Everything that changes when you come from 0.5.5 is in the [full notes](https://github.com/jazzenchen/agent-hud-open/releases/tag/v0.6.0).
### What's new since 0.5.5
- **A new app, built for every desktop.** - A Rust core works out tokens, quotas, prices and sessions the same way on every system. Agent HUD now runs on Intel Macs too, with test builds for Windows and Linux. - Its own updater checks once a day and verifies every update before it installs. You can also install from a terminal: `brew install --cask jazzenchen/tap/agent-hud` or `npx @agenthud/install`. - Details: [0.6.0-beta.1](https://github.com/jazzenchen/agent-hud-open/releases/tag/v0.6.0-beta.1), [0.6.0-beta.4](https://github.com/jazzenchen/agent-hud-open/releases/tag/v0.6.0-beta.4), [0.6.0-beta.7](https://github.com/jazzenchen/agent-hud-open/releases/tag/v0.6.0-beta.7) - **Many more agents.** Each appears once Agent HUD finds it on your computer. - New: Devin, Qoder, TRAE, Factory Droid, Hermes, Cline, Roo Code, Goose, Kilo Code, MiMo Code and Oh My Pi. Some are read from their published formats and not yet checked on a real install. - Followed more closely: Antigravity's sessions and approvals, Cursor's sessions and tokens, and DeepSeek Harness through Agent HUD's own plugin. - Details: [0.6.0-beta.1](https://github.com/jazzenchen/agent-hud-open/releases/tag/v0.6.0-beta.1), [0.6.0-beta.4](https://github.com/jazzenchen/agent-hud-open/releases/tag/v0.6.0-beta.4), [0.6.0-beta.5](https://github.com/jazzenchen/agent-hud-open/releases/tag/v0.6.0-beta.5), [0.6.0-beta.6](https://github.com/jazzenchen/agent-hud-open/releases/tag/v0.6.0-beta.6) - **Answer more agents from the HUD.** - Requests now come from the Claude desktop app, Antigravity, DeepSeek Harness, Devin and Factory Droid, and from Copilot CLI once you turn it on in Settings → Agents → Copilot. - Return to session on a request card brings its session forward. A Claude Code closed while it waited no longer leaves its request open for half an hour. - Details: [0.6.0-beta.1](https://github.com/jazzenchen/agent-hud-open/releases/tag/v0.6.0-beta.1), [0.6.0-beta.4](https://github.com/jazzenchen/agent-hud-open/releases/tag/v0.6.0-beta.4), [0.6.0-beta.5](https://github.com/jazzenchen/agent-hud-open/releases/tag/v0.6.0-beta.5), [0.6.0-beta.6](https://github.com/jazzenchen/agent-hud-open/releases/tag/v0.6.0-beta.6), [0.6.0-beta.7](https://github.com/jazzenchen/agent-hud-open/releases/tag/v0.6.0-beta.7), [0.6.0-beta.8](https://github.com/jazzenchen/agent-hud-open/releases/tag/v0.6.0-beta.8) - **Agents work together.** - Claude Code and Codex sessions can message other sessions or start new ones through Agent HUD's MCP server. A message waits until the receiver is idle, and a paper plane carries it across the HUD. - Agents can read your usage and sessions from Agent HUD and build its hover panel with controls of their own. Turn these on in Settings → Agent plugins. - Details: [0.6.0-beta.1](https://github.com/jazzenchen/agent-hud-open/releases/tag/v0.6.0-beta.1), [0.6.0-beta.5](https://github.com/jazzenchen/agent-hud-open/releases/tag/v0.6.0-beta.5), [0.6.0-beta.7](https://github.com/jazzenchen/agent-hud-open/releases/tag/v0.6.0-beta.7) - **Quotas, plans and balances for many more accounts.** - New: MiniMax and Volcengine Ark plans, ClinePass and Factory Droid limits, Hermes's Nous Portal credits, and Qoder's and TRAE's credits after you sign in inside Agent HUD. Relays show their balance, and a Prices page lets you correct what a model costs. - More than one account for Codex, Antigravity and Claude Code. An agent that signs out keeps its last reading, and the HUD tells you. - Details: [0.6.0-beta.3](https://github.com/jazzenchen/agent-hud-open/releases/tag/v0.6.0-beta.3), [0.6.0-beta.4](https://github.com/jazzenchen/agent-hud-open/releases/tag/v0.6.0-beta.4), [0.6.0-beta.6](https://github.com/jazzenchen/agent-hud-open/releases/tag/v0.6.0-beta.6), [0.6.0-beta.7](https://github.com/jazzenchen/agent-hud-open/releases/tag/v0.6.0-beta.7) - **The HUD shows more at a glance.** - Two modes, Notch and Simple. Simple marks and the panel can draw usage as rings, segments, bars or numbers. - Cards park at the ends of the dock: requests at the head until you answer them, messages at the tail until they fade. The hover panel can also show Quota history and Plan value. - Details: [0.6.0-beta.6](https://github.com/jazzenchen/agent-hud-open/releases/tag/v0.6.0-beta.6), [0.6.0-beta.7](https://github.com/jazzenchen/agent-hud-open/releases/tag/v0.6.0-beta.7), [0.6.0-beta.8](https://github.com/jazzenchen/agent-hud-open/releases/tag/v0.6.0-beta.8) - **Statistics opens on a Usage dashboard, with your whole history behind it.** - Filter by agent, token kind and range, up to a year, then read headline figures with their trends, a heatmap, each plan's value against its price, and a card per agent with its quota by day. The Mac keeps every token it records. - The Sessions tab charts each session's turns, context and sub-agents. - Details: [0.6.0-beta.1](https://github.com/jazzenchen/agent-hud-open/releases/tag/v0.6.0-beta.1), [0.6.0-beta.5](https://github.com/jazzenchen/agent-hud-open/releases/tag/v0.6.0-beta.5), [0.6.0-beta.6](https://github.com/jazzenchen/agent-hud-open/releases/tag/v0.6.0-beta.6), [0.6.0-beta.8](https://github.com/jazzenchen/agent-hud-open/releases/tag/v0.6.0-beta.8) - **More for your iPhone and Apple Watch.** - Each day's usage arrives priced at API list prices. On the local network, changes reach the iPhone as they happen and the Mac offers its Tailscale address too. Once every iPhone runs Agent HUD for iPhone 1.7.6 or later, the text of approval and reminder banners stays in the end-to-end encrypted part of iCloud records. - Details: [0.6.0-beta.3](https://github.com/jazzenchen/agent-hud-open/releases/tag/v0.6.0-beta.3), [0.6.0-beta.4](https://github.com/jazzenchen/agent-hud-open/releases/tag/v0.6.0-beta.4), [0.6.0-beta.6](https://github.com/jazzenchen/agent-hud-open/releases/tag/v0.6.0-beta.6)
### All beta release notes

# Agent HUD 0.5.5
## Compatibility
**Requires Agent HUD for iPhone 1.5 or later** for iPhone and Apple Watch sync. Update the iPhone app before updating the Mac. Older iPhone versions cannot read this release's data.
[Get the iPhone app](https://apps.apple.com/app/id6812113619).
Requires an Apple Silicon Mac running macOS 14 or later.
## Changes
### Quota names on every device
- Keeps quota window names and short forms in English, so an English iPhone, widget or Apple Watch no longer receives Chinese names from a Mac using Chinese. Names update after the Mac reads and syncs the account again.
### Docks and appearance
- Keeps every logo visible on Simple and Dynamic docks while a reply or request opens beside the sending agent's logo. - Gives each display its own dark, light or system appearance, solid or glass material and transparency. Settings → General can match windows to their display's HUD as an experimental option. - Lets both dock sizes run from 20 to 60 pt, adds Simple panel logo spacing and uses one smaller text size for dock numbers, reminders and the hover line. - Makes the agents' bots act out thinking, tools, approvals, questions, plans, compaction, failures and usage limits. Claude's bot is Clawd. - Keeps the menu bar's figure, colours and agent order in step with the main display's HUD and its layout.
### Arrange the HUD with an agent
- Adds client checkmarks and add/remove actions for the MCP server in Settings → Experimental. - Names the tools `get_hud`, `get_hud_screenshot`, `draft_hud`, `discard_hud_draft` and `finish_hud_edit`. The server remains `agent-hud`; turn on the renamed HUD tools switch again to use it. - Lets an agent filter sessions by project and period, choose block accounts and row order, change panel switches and propose app settings as a draft for you to save. - Holds the panel open while an agent arranges it, then lets go when the edit finishes or you dismiss it. - Adds balance burn rates, estimated run-out times and cost charts to API balance blocks.
### Sessions and other agents
- Removes archived or deleted sessions from session lists while keeping their tokens in the usage totals until the ledger expires them. - Lets a session using a tool take over an agent's mark from one that is thinking. - Answers Claude Code plan approvals on the HUD, including accepting edits or returning feedback to keep planning. - Ends Claude Code turns promptly when their logs report a usage limit or API failure. - Keeps one provider order across Settings, the HUD, glow, menu bar and token statistics. - Shows WorkBuddy's model ceilings and credits, reads a GLM plan held only by WorkBuddy under that group and handles a CodeBuddy CLI using WorkBuddy's configuration as WorkBuddy. - Reduces artwork memory, repeated island layout and process inspection for clients that are not installed.
### iPhone and Apple Watch sync
- Sends Claude's narrations and questions to the phone, including questions answered through the Claude desktop app's next-step box. - Keeps published turn text once and improves local-network change tracking and conversation-cache recovery. - Ships the Mac executable stripped and the updater for Apple Silicon only, while keeping debugging symbols locally for crash reports.
